title: Calling a flaky payment API

concepts.description: Doubling the wait between retries spreads load, and adding random jitter stops many clients retrying in lockstep.
concepts.context: adds random jitter to the doubling delay in charge()

concepts.description: A key sent with a request lets the server recognise a repeat and return the first result instead of acting twice.
concepts.context: sends the request id as an Idempotency-Key header on every retry
